summary: Provider-neutral remote access plan. SSH-cloud is the global lane for everyone; VPN is the private lane for team members and companies. Every tier stays inactive until its confirmation questions are answered.

tiers.intent: Cloud SSH for everyone: a hardened cloud VM, a browser-based web SSH terminal, and cloud development environments for developers.

requiredQuestions.question: Which cloud host or VM should accept SSH connections?
Which public URL should serve the browser web SSH terminal?
Which identity/auth provider gates access (SSO, GitHub, key-only)?
Who can revoke keys and shut access if it is exposed to the wrong people?

confirmationFlow.safeDefault: keep activeTarget null until host, public URL, auth provider, and rollback owner are confirmed

tiers.intent: Private VPN for team members and partner companies. Access is identity-scoped, not public.
tiers.recommendationReason: WireGuard-based mesh that is self-hostable, brings SSO + ACLs out of the box, and scales from a small team to multiple companies without per-peer manual config. WireGuard alone is the recommended fallback when full self-control of the protocol layer is required.

requiredQuestions.question: Which VPN solution is approved (netbird, wireguard, tailscale, openvpn)?
Which management/control plane URL or tailnet identifies the network?
Which SSO/identity source authorizes team members and companies?
Where are the access rules (ACLs) defined and who owns them?

confirmationFlow.safeDefault: keep activeTarget null until the solution, control plane, identity source, and ACL owner are confirmed
